column1: # The acceptance sample's stimulus for the verification run on mps2/an521
# (decision 0014 §10): a 50 ms horizon, 20 ms to drain; the emulated ADC
# steps through three levels, the button is pressed and released, three
# commands arrive on the inbound channel (the third with a payload above
# the channel's 8 bytes, dropped as oversize) early enough for the 10 ms
# command_poll to consume the two that queue before the horizon -- the
# transport thread, lowest in priority and slowed by the recorder, delivers
# a frame a few milliseconds after it is sent, and an inbound message still
# queued at H fails the run (§10) -- and the nesting source runs every 700 us
# with 150 us of busy work so the 1 ms system-clock expiries land inside it.
